item.title: UFC 328 Livestream: Here’s Where to Watch Khamzat Chimaev vs. Sean Strickland Live Online
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest news and updates from the world of entertainment and sports. Today, we're talking about the upcoming UFC 328 event, featuring a thrilling matchup between Khamzat Chimaev and Sean Strickland. Let's dive in!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "UFC 328 is set to take place on May 9th at the Prudential Center in Newark, New Jersey. The main event will feature Russian-Emirati fighter Khamzat Chimaev defending his UFC Middleweight Championship belt against American Sean Strickland. The main card is expected to start around 9 p.m. ET, so mark your calendars!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "If you can't make it to the live event, don't worry. You can catch UFC 328 live online through Paramount+. The prelims will also be broadcast live on CBS, starting at 7 p.m. ET. And, if you sign up for Walmart+, you can get Paramount+ for just $1. That's right, a 30-day trial for just $1, with access to tons of TV shows and movies."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Other options to catch the fight include DirecTV, which is offering a five-day free trial for new subscribers. Prices start at $19.99 per month, but their 'Choice' package is a great value at $84.99 per month for the first 24 months. And, if you prefer Fubo, you can choose from four packages, all of which include CBS, starting at $48.99 for your first month."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's it for today, folks. UFC 328 is shaping up to be an exciting event, and we hope you can catch it live online or through one of the many streaming options available. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
